Class ShipConstructionDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.ActionJSON.State.StateDTO
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am28.Model.ActionJSON.State.ShipConstruction.ShipConstructionDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class ShipConstructionDTO extends StateDTO
Represents a data transfer data object that holds all the main information necessary for the ship construction phase * Annotations from the Jackson library are used for JSON serialization and deserialization, * ensuring that only non-null values are included in the JSON output.
